query: We just spent 20 minutes figuring out the right flags to migrate our Prisma schema safely in staging. Can you turn that workflow into a reusable skill under skills/prisma-safe-migrate?
Scaffold a new reference-heavy skill in skills/openapi-conventions with starter evals and split the pagination and error payload rules into references/.
Our skills/docker-multi-stage/SKILL.md is 620 lines long and fails strict skill validation because of unknown frontmatter keys. Refactor it to follow progressive disclosure.
Write a SKILL.md description for our new changelog-generator skill so it triggers on release prep prompts but does not trigger on git commit message questions.
Create a new scripted skill skills/svg-icon-optimizer that bundles a non-interactive Node script under scripts/ and documents when to use it.
Help me design a first-party Agent Skill for configuring Vitest workspaces, including SKILL.md frontmatter, reference files, and 3 starter eval cases.
I have a draft SKILL.md with chained links from references/overview.md to references/details.md and a README.md in the skill folder. Clean it up to meet the Agent Skills spec.
What fields are allowed in SKILL.md YAML frontmatter under strict validation and how should I structure the description field?
Package our team's GraphQL schema deprecation checklist into a new skill at skills/graphql-deprecation with references/examples.md.
Use yarn agents-config skill new to scaffold a basic skill for Tailwind v4 migration and fill out the SKILL.md workflow and starter trigger_queries.json.
Run the benchmark suite for skills/eslint-configuration with 3 runs per variant and tell me the pass-rate delta between with_skill and without_skill.
Compute trigger precision, recall, and false positive rate on the validation split of skills/prettier-configuration/evals/trigger_queries.json.
Regenerate report.md from ~/.agents/agents-config/evals/eslint-configuration/iteration-2/benchmark.json and list any non-discriminating assertions.
Add a new global instruction block under blocks/engineering/error-handling.md and register it in blocks/index.yaml.
Set up ESLint v9 flat config in eslint.config.mjs for our TypeScript monorepo with simple-import-sort.
Add the upstream anthropics/skills pdf skill to catalog.yaml pinned to its latest commit SHA.
Run yarn agents-config init --global --yes to install our configured instruction blocks and skills for Claude Code and Codex.
Write unit tests in src/install/plan.test.ts to verify symlink replacement when switching from copy to link mode.
Configure Prettier in .prettierrc with singleQuote: true and add a .prettierignore for build artifacts.
Check why yarn agents-config doctor reports that ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md is out of date.
